name: znote-conversation-notes
description: Turn AI conversations into illustrated learning notes and save them to ZNote.

interface.shortDescription: 把 AI 对话提炼成可复习的 ZNote 图文笔记。
interface.longDescription: 整理 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等 AI 对话，保留关键推理、出处、图片、可复用方法和复习问题，并按需安全写入 ZNote。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $znote-conversation-notes to turn this conversation into an illustrated learning note and save it to ZNote.
